subject: Can somebody help me to achieve the following?

messages.author: 4b890229d8cfaf55
messages.subject: Can somebody help me to achieve the following?
parts:
Dear all,

Please consider my following plot:

p <- ggplot() + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 10)) +
scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 4, ymin = -Inf, ymax =
Inf, fill = "darkorchid3", , alpha = I(0.3)) +
annotate("rect", xmin = 4, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
fill = "firebrick1", , alpha = I(0.3)) +
geom_point(aes(x = 1:10, y = rnorm(10, 50, 20))) +
geom_text(aes(x = 4.8, y = 50, label = "Some Points"), size = 10)
p


Now what I want is to truncate the text '"Some Points' in the left
side in the plot window, so that there should not be any word on the
left rectangle (which is violate color).

Can somebody give me any suggestion on how to achieve that?

Thanks and regards,

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Can somebody help me to achieve the following?
parts:
You didn't provide any sample data or an image, so it's hard to know
what might help. Reduce the text size? Add a carriage return ("\n")
between the two words? Move the text?

Ben
